# Check — M0-e-01, hardening round S2, closing check (lane `check/M0-e-01-close-s2`, flow-7, 2026-11-10)

The closing check of M0-e-01's session hardening round S2 (lane `build/M0-e-01-fix-s2`; J237 (2), J238, J186, J192),
leg 1 of the merged round M0-e-01 S2 → M0-e-02 S2 → M0-e-03 S4 (J443, J733). The round took one row: the queue's
Q87 in its M0-e-01 part (`docs/M0-FIX-QUEUE.md`, read whole by `grep '^| Q87 '`) — the hand-written lifecycle in
`site/src/terrain/heightfield.ts` replaced by `@plat/model`'s `generatedLifecycle`, as a NO-SHIFT change. This
checker is not the round's author. It read the queue row, the builder (`model/src/stage/lifecycle.ts`) and the
terrain code, wrote its probe plan, and ran its own before-image, NO-SHIFT probe and mutants before it read the
author's 'Hardening round S2' section, choices row C-0489 or CLEAN-ROOM row L-0797. Mutants and probes ran only in
its own mirror `/home/user/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-e-01/mirror` (a tar copy without `node_modules`, installed
and built there: `@plat/kernel`, `@plat/model` and `@plat/tables` resolve inside it), deleted afterwards. The first
check's file `checks/M0-e-01.md` and the earlier verdicts `M0-e-01-c1.md` and `M0-e-01-s1.md` are unchanged (J269).

## Verdict: PASS

**PASS.** The round's one row is fixed and confirmed with this checker's own evidence, every gate of M0.md §3
step 3 exits 0 — RELATED@1000 included: 280 files, 3 523 tests, none failed — and no new finding is a blocker. The
check ran in two seats of this lane (J714's long-wait hand-off): the first planned and ran the probes, the mutants and
the gates but RELATED, which it started as a detached chain; the finishing seat read the chain's logs, re-read the
sources the results rest on (the queue row, `heightfield.ts`, the builder, the pin, the before-image's diff, the
mutants' logs and exit codes, the probe's two outputs) and closed the rows below. Nothing was re-run that had a log
and its exit code.

* **The row is closed: Q87-e01 fixed, confirmed with this checker's own evidence (CONFIRMED).** `heightfield.ts`
  imports `generatedLifecycle` from `@plat/model`, keeps the file-level name as `export { generatedLifecycle };`
  (the very function) and `record()` — under both `buildTerrain` and `flatTerrain` — stamps through it. No
  hand-written lifecycle literal is left in `site/src/terrain/`.
* **The pin is red without the fix and kills its mutant (CONFIRMED).** `strategy.test.ts` "stamps the record with
  @plat/model's one lifecycle builder: the same function, −0 written as 0, an unlawful epoch thrown" fails on the
  checker's own before-image (M1). 18 targeted mutants of the checker's own: 16 killed; 2 survive NEAR (M14, M16) —
  one finding, note N-s2-5, judged not a blocker (section (4)).
* **NO-SHIFT holds for every lawful input (CONFIRMED).** 233 lawful runs — 216 `baseTerrain` stage records, 9
  `flatTerrain` records, 4 `runRivers` and 4 `runS1` runs (the siblings that import the name by path) — are
  byte-identical between the before-image and the tree. Nothing is declared as a shift; no golden or digest is
  re-recorded.
* **The refusal census is 0 → 0 (CONFIRMED)**, 233 lawful runs before and after. Only unlawful epochs at the raw
  doors moved (a silently stamped record → the builder's RangeError), as Q87 states ("the refusal of an unlawful
  epoch inherited").
* **One in-memory difference, on an epoch no document holds, is routed to the session (N-s2-1 / N-s2-6):** epoch −0
  gave `since.epoch` −0 and gives +0. JSON and the leaf digest do not see it. Not a blocker.
* **The API is frozen (J263 Q1; CONFIRMED):** `terrain/index.ts` changed in one comment line; `heightfield.ts`
  exports the same five names; no message text of the item changed.
* **Gates:** `landed:verify flow-7 --item M0-e-01` ok; `install --frozen-lockfile` 0; `lint` 0 (probe-red ok);
  `build` 0; NEAR 9 files 87/87 at the PR size; RELATED@1000 0 — 280 files, 3 523/3 523; `landed:verify` ok again
  after it; `lint` 0 again after this check's appends.

## (4) New findings — the blocker rule

None is a blocker:

* No gate exits non-zero (RELATED@1000 included).
* No listed interface or test id is missing.
* No stub or shortcut on an honest code path.
* No wrong result on an honest input: every lawful line is byte-identical to the before-image's.
* No path of the item lies outside `plat/`.
* This checker read only rule-1 material.

Four notes are appended to `checks/M0-e-01-notes.md` ('Hardening round S2 — the closing check's notes'):

* **N-s2-5 — the two survivors.** M14 and M16 keep the builder's call and then overwrite `flags.locked` or
  `existence` on the `buildTerrain` path only; NEAR stays 87/87, because the stamp's whole value is compared only on
  the flat path (`raster.test.ts:163`; the pin's 2^53 − 1 line), while the stage path pins the function's identity,
  `since`, the −0 flush, the RangeError and freshness. They are not equivalent. The checker judges them a
  deliberate-writer escape and a tightening of a claim, not a blocker: the row's own mutant (the before-image) and
  every natural alternative (a literal on either path, a wrapper, a memo, a swallowed refusal, a dropped epoch) are
  killed; the gap predates the round; and the tree's value is right on both paths (225 lifecycles printed). Suggested
  pin: `expect(t.lifecycle).toEqual(modelLifecycle(3))` in "writes the record". No terrain record's lifecycle is read
  outside `site/test/terrain`, so RELATED would not kill them either (PLAUSIBLE, by grep). The finishing seat re-read the
  pin and the two record tests and agrees: the mutants' exit codes are 0 (`s2/mut2/M14.rc`, `M16.rc`), the leaf digest
  does read `existence` and `flags` (`model/src/digest/leaf.ts:107`), but nothing outside `@plat/model`
  puts a terrain entry into a digest (grep for `.put(`, `digestLeaf(` and `kind: 'terrain'` over the packages' sources and
  tests and `bench/`: no line), and the
  lane's precedent for a non-equivalent survivor on a gap older than the round is a note (`M0-e-01-c1.md`: RG1, L2,
  L3 → N-c1-1, N-c1-2, N-c1-6, closed by the next round).
* **N-s2-6 — epoch −0 (the author's N-s2-1), for the session's ruling.** The brief's NO-SHIFT clause asks that a
  field where the builder's value differs be reported, not declared. It was reported; the switch was made and the
  pin asserts +0. The checker's measure agrees with the author's: only `Object.is` sees the difference, on an epoch
  no document holds. The row stands as fixed unless the session rules to keep −0.
* **N-s2-7 — the author's `git log`** (N-s2-4): procedural, routed to the session as N-s1-2 was.
* **N-s2-8 — a comment in M0-m-01's `stage/lifecycle.ts:3`** says the leaf reads `since`; `digest/leaf.ts:139` says
  it does not. Another item's file; a comment fix for its next round.

## Ledger

The checker's rows in `CLEAN-ROOM.md` §2 are written by this lane on 2026-11-10 (role: closing checker of M0-e-01's
hardening round S2, not its author): the first seat's row L-0798 (the probes, the mutants, the gates but RELATED,
the draft) and the finishing seat's row L-0799 (the chain's logs read and judged, the verdict, the records). No file of the item was changed. Mutants ran only in the mirror, which
was restored and deleted (its `node_modules` first). No git command was run.

**A seat error, disclosed.** At 04:46:24 the first mirror script ran `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in
the project root: `rsync` is absent on this machine, the script's `cd <mirror>` failed and the next line ran in the
launch directory. It created `/home/user/maps-architecture/package.json` (231 bytes, an empty default manifest),
`pnpm-lock.yaml` (114 bytes, no dependency) and `node_modules/` (two state files) — birth times 04:46:24, none
existed before. The checker removed exactly those (four named files, one `rmdir`) at once and wrote the lane-log line.
Nothing under `plat/` was touched by it; corepack also cached pnpm 12.18.0 in the user cache, outside the project
(`plat/` pins its own pnpm 10.34.6, which every gate above used). The mirror was then made by `tar` with a guarded
`cd`.
